visual_action: The video first displays a screenshot of a tweet from the account 'Pop Base'. The tweet reports that an ICE officer shot and killed a woman in Minneapolis. Below the text are two images: a tactical vest with a 'POLICE ICE' patch and the seal of the U.S. Department of Homeland Security. The video then cuts to a clip of several law enforcement officers in tactical gear on a snowy street, surrounding a dark-colored SUV that is emitting exhaust.
